description: This file defines a class 'FuzzedSparseTensor' for generating and manipulating sparse tensors in PyTorch, including methods for constructing sparse tensors with specific properties and attributes.

classes.name: FuzzedSparseTensor
classes.description: A subclass of FuzzedTensor for generating sparse tensors with customizable properties such as density, coalescing, and sparse dimensions.

methods.name: sparse_tensor_constructor
methods.description: Creates a sparse COO tensor with specified size, data type, sparse dimensions, number of non-zero elements, and coalescing status.

methods.name: _make_tensor
methods.description: Generates a sparse tensor based on input parameters like size, density, and coalescing, and returns the tensor along with its properties.
